data.content: Shqiptarisht is an idea that has been on our minds for many years, almost 13 years, and finally, the conditions came together for this idea to come to life on a website (for which a word could also be invented) dedicated to creating new Albanian words, with the goal of “cleaning” and enriching our native language.

Based on a phenomenon we often encounter, the differences in the way objects, tools, professions, etc., are named, as well as the limitation of our language, Shqiptarisht aligns with a collaborative space, where Albanians can create new words for foreign expressions that are adopted daily, as well as vote on inventions and suggestions they find suitable.
In this way, we foster a spirit of cooperation while creating new words for our language, building a shared, contemporary dictionary that reflects the development of the Albanian language.
This space is entirely voluntary and thrives on the goodwill to enrich Albanian, so everyone is invited to contribute!
